input.question: Which key does your game use for crouch? I couldn't find a row already labeled "crouch," so I want to bind the right one to a soft left sip.

options.label: Row 79: kb_left_control (Ctrl) — the usual crouch key, currently on a triple sip
Row 84: kb_c (C key) — currently on a plain left sip
Row 82: kb_z (Z key) — currently on a soft right puff
